skills.description: Cross-market investment opportunity discovery, screening, evaluation, and tracking system. This skill should be used when users need to find investment opportunities across primary market (PE/VC, Pre-IPO, M&A, private placement), secondary market (A-share/HK/US equities: subjective low-valuation high-dividend long-hold L25, objective quantitative L25, undervalued dividend + quant enhancement L24), alternative investments (real estate, infrastructure, commodities), and overseas markets; screen and filter opportunities by industry, stage, size, and risk profile; evaluate opportunities with professional frameworks including financial analysis, industry thesis, risk assessment, and valuation; generate structured investment recommendations and IC memos; track opportunities through the investment lifecycle. Triggers include find investment opportunities, screen deals, evaluate this opportunity, investment thesis, deal sourcing, 机会筛选, 投资评估, 项目尽调, 投资建议, 机会雷达, 低估红利, 白云山, 主观投资, 客观量化.
skills.description_zh: Cross-market investment opportunity discovery, screening, evaluation, and tracking system covering primary market, secondary market, alternative investments, and overseas markets.

skills.description: 运用埃隆·马斯克第一性原理进行创新突破的顾问。通过选项式提问，运用第一性原理、十倍思维、物理学思维、五步算法、快速迭代、成本解构等核心理念，帮助用户打破常规、实现指数级突破、解决看似不可能的问题。适用于：技术创新、成本优化、创业突破、解决不可能的问题、指数级增长、流程简化。当用户需要突破常规、用第一性原理思考、解决看似不可能的问题时使用本Skill。
